faqs.question: How do I switch accounts on YouTube?
faqs.answer: Tap your profile → Switch account → Choose another account.

faqs.question: How do I sign out of YouTube?
faqs.answer: Tap your profile → Manage accounts on this device → Remove from this device.

faqs.question: How do I turn on captions?
faqs.answer: Tap Settings (⚙️) → Captions → Choose language.

faqs.question: How do I change caption language?
faqs.answer: Tap Settings (⚙️) → Captions → Language → pick a language.

faqs.question: How do I change playback speed?
faqs.answer: Tap Settings (⚙️) → Playback speed → choose a speed.

faqs.question: How do I change video quality?
faqs.answer: Tap Settings (⚙️) → Quality → choose Auto or a resolution.

faqs.question: How do I enable dark theme?
faqs.answer: Tap your profile → Settings → Appearance → Dark theme.

faqs.question: How do I turn on restricted mode?
faqs.answer: Tap your profile → Settings → General → Restricted Mode → On.

faqs.question: How do I find my watch history?
faqs.answer: Tap Library → History to see your recent videos.

faqs.question: How do I clear my watch history?
faqs.answer: Tap Library → History → ⋮ → Clear all watch history.

faqs.question: How do I pause watch history?
faqs.answer: Tap Library → History → ⋮ → Pause watch history.

faqs.question: How do I like a video?
faqs.answer: Open the video → tap 👍 Like below the player.

faqs.question: How do I dislike a video?
faqs.answer: Open the video → tap 👎 Dislike below the player.

faqs.question: How do I subscribe to a channel?
faqs.answer: Open a video or channel page → tap Subscribe.

faqs.question: How do I turn on notifications for a channel?
faqs.answer: On the channel page → tap the bell 🔔 → choose All.

faqs.question: How do I add a video to Watch Later?
faqs.answer: Under a video → tap Save → choose Watch Later.

faqs.question: How do I create a playlist?
faqs.answer: Tap Library → New playlist → select videos → name it → Create.

faqs.question: How do I add a video to a playlist?
faqs.answer: Under the video → tap Save → select a playlist.

faqs.question: How do I remove a video from a playlist?
faqs.answer: Open the playlist → tap ⋮ on a video → Remove from playlist.

faqs.question: How do I share a video?
faqs.answer: Under the video → tap Share → choose an app or copy link.

faqs.question: How do I download videos for offline viewing?
faqs.answer: If available in your region/plan: tap Download under the video → choose quality.

faqs.question: How do I change download quality?
faqs.answer: Library → Downloads → ⋮ → Download settings → choose quality.

faqs.question: How do I turn on autoplay?
faqs.answer: On the video page → toggle Autoplay switch next to Up next.

faqs.question: How do I report a video?
faqs.answer: Below the video → tap ⋮ → Report → choose a reason → Submit.

faqs.question: How do I block or hide a channel?
faqs.answer: On the channel page → tap ⋮ → Don’t recommend channel (or Block on mobile Kids settings).

faqs.question: How do I change comment visibility or sort order?
faqs.answer: Open comments → tap Sort by → choose Top or Newest.

faqs.question: How do I turn on ambient mode?
faqs.answer: During playback → tap Settings (⚙️) or player options → Ambient mode → On.

faqs.question: How do I cast YouTube to my TV?
faqs.answer: Tap the Cast icon ☐◀ on the top → choose your TV device.

faqs.question: How do I change region or content location?
faqs.answer: Tap your profile → Settings → General → Location → pick a country.

faqs.question: How do I manage YouTube Premium membership?
faqs.answer: Tap your profile → Purchases and memberships → Manage.
